functions.name: is_key_down
functions.doc: True while the key is held

functions.name: is_key_pressed
functions.doc: True on the frame the key went down

functions.name: is_key_released
functions.doc: True on the frame the key went up

functions.name: mouse_position
functions.doc: Mouse position in viewport pixels (top-left origin)

functions.name: mouse_delta
functions.doc: Mouse movement this frame in pixels

functions.name: scroll_delta
functions.doc: Scroll wheel movement this frame

functions.name: viewport_size
functions.doc: Size of the game viewport in pixels

functions.name: action_names
functions.doc: The project's input actions, sorted by name

functions.name: is_action_down
functions.doc: True while any input bound to the action is held

functions.name: is_action_pressed
functions.doc: True on the frame the action started

functions.name: is_action_released
functions.doc: True on the frame the action ended

functions.name: gamepad_connected
functions.doc: True while a gamepad is connected

functions.name: ui_wants_pointer
functions.doc: True while the game UI is using the pointer (over a panel or button, or a modal canvas is shown); the mouse buttons then read as up

functions.name: ui_wants_keyboard
functions.doc: True while the game UI is using the keyboard and gamepad (a modal canvas is shown); keys and buttons then read as up

functions.name: ui_clear_focus
functions.doc: Takes focus away from the UI

functions.name: is_gamepad_down
functions.doc: True while the gamepad button ("A", "Start", "DPadLeft", ...) is held

functions.name: is_gamepad_pressed
functions.doc: True on the frame the gamepad button went down

functions.name: is_gamepad_released
functions.doc: True on the frame the gamepad button went up

functions.name: delta_time
functions.doc: Seconds since the previous frame

functions.name: time
functions.doc: Seconds since play started

functions.name: frame
functions.doc: Frames since play started

functions.name: find_path
functions.doc: The corners of the shortest walkable path from start to end on the scene's navmesh, both ends included; an empty list when either end is off the navmesh or nothing connects them. When the end can't be reached, the path goes as close as it can

functions.name: nearest_navigable_point
functions.doc: The nearest point agents can stand on, within 'search' meters to the side, or None

functions.name: is_navigable
functions.doc: True when an agent can stand at the point: over the navmesh, within a step of its surface

functions.name: bake_navigation
functions.doc: Bakes the scene's navmesh again from its static colliders, for worlds built while the game runs. A big world takes a moment; raises an error saying why when there's nothing to walk on

functions.name: raycast
functions.doc: Casts a ray against physics colliders (play mode); returns RaycastHit or None

functions.name: create_entity
functions.doc: Creates an entity in the active scene

functions.name: tween
functions.doc: Moves a property smoothly from where it is to 'to' over 'seconds': an entity's position, local_position, rotation or scale, or a component's number or vector property as "Component.property" ("UIImage.color", "AudioSource.volume"). A new tween of the same property replaces the running one

functions.name: tween_by
functions.doc: Like tween, but adds 'amount' to the property; a rotation turns by the full amount, more than one turn too

functions.name: stop_tweens
functions.doc: Stops an entity's tweens, or only those of one property, sending no 'tween finished'; returns how many it stopped

functions.name: ui_focused
functions.doc: The UI entity with keyboard and gamepad focus, or None

functions.name: ui_hovered
functions.doc: The UI entity under the pointer that the pointer can use, or None

functions.name: shake_camera
functions.doc: Shakes the game camera's view, fading out over 'seconds' (at most 10): strength 1 moves it up to 0.15 m and turns it up to 1.5 degrees (at most 10). Only the picture moves, not the camera's Transform; a stronger shake replaces a weaker one, and a paused game holds it

functions.name: find_tagged
functions.doc: Every entity of the scene with the tag, parents before their children; an empty list when there are none

functions.name: group
functions.doc: The Hierarchy group with this name (any letter case), or None

functions.name: groups
functions.doc: Every Hierarchy group of the scene, in the order the Hierarchy shows them

functions.name: create_group
functions.doc: Adds a Hierarchy group at the end of the list. The name is trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, and not used by another group in any letter case; a scene has at most 256 groups

functions.name: get_entities
functions.doc: All entities (optionally only those with a component), in hierarchy order

functions.name: instantiate
functions.doc: Spawns a .bprefab and returns its root entity

functions.name: screen_to_world_ray
functions.doc: Returns (origin, direction) of a ray through a viewport pixel, or None without a camera

functions.name: load_scene
functions.doc: Switches to another scene at the end of the frame

functions.name: save_screenshot
functions.doc: Saves what the player sees as a PNG (or JPEG for .jpg) and returns its full path; "" names it Screenshots/<scene>-<date>-<time>.png and relative paths are inside user_folder()

functions.name: log_folder
functions.doc: user_folder()/Logs, where a game playing in its own window writes Game.log, and Game.previous.log from its last run (playing inside the editor logs to the editor's Console instead)

functions.name: user_folder
functions.doc: The game's own writable folder for saves, screenshots and reports

functions.name: save_data
functions.doc: Saves a value (nothing, true/false, numbers, text, vectors, lists and maps) as user_folder()/Saves/<name>.json; false when it can't be written

functions.name: load_data
functions.doc: The value saved under the name, or default when there is none (a damaged save is kept as <name>.damaged.json)

functions.name: load_json
functions.doc: Reads a JSON data file from the Assets folder ("Data/items.json"): objects become maps (dicts in Python), arrays lists. Read-only game data that ships with the game, unlike save_data; read again only when the file changes

functions.name: load_text
functions.doc: Reads a text file from the Assets folder ("Data/intro.txt"), read again only when it changes

functions.name: has_data
functions.doc: True when a value is saved under the name

functions.name: delete_data
functions.doc: Deletes the value saved under the name; false when there was none

functions.name: real_time
functions.doc: Real-world seconds since January 1, 1970 (UTC); keeps counting while the game is closed, unlike time()

functions.name: set_paused
functions.doc: Pauses or resumes the game: physics, time() and scripts stop, except scripts marked Run While Paused; the UI still answers. A new scene starts unpaused

functions.name: is_paused
functions.doc: True while the game is paused (set_paused)

functions.name: quit
functions.doc: Quits the game (stops play mode in the editor)

functions.name: started_from_editor
functions.doc: True while the game plays in the editor (its viewport, or a game window it started); false in an exported game

functions.name: play_sound
functions.doc: Plays a one-shot 2D sound

functions.name: bus_names
functions.doc: The audio buses: Master, Music, Effects

functions.name: set_bus_volume
functions.doc: Sets a bus's volume (1 = normal, 0 = silent)

functions.name: set_bus_muted
functions.doc: Mutes or unmutes a bus; its volume is kept

types.name: Material
types.doc: PBR material that can be assigned to a MeshRenderer

members.name: load
members.doc: Loads a .bmat material from the project

members.name: unlit
members.doc: Shown as its albedo (and emissive) with no lights, shade or shadows on it, for flat-shaded art and sprites. It still casts shadows

members.name: texture_filter
members.doc: How its textures are read between pixels: "Linear" (smooth) or "Nearest" (pixelated, for pixel art and palettes)

members.name: wrap_u
members.doc: What its textures do past their left and right edges: "Repeat", "Clamp" or "Mirror"

members.name: wrap_v
members.doc: What its textures do past their top and bottom edges: "Repeat", "Clamp" or "Mirror"

members.name: albedo_map
members.doc: Albedo (base color) texture path, or None

members.name: normal_map
members.doc: Tangent-space normal map path, or None

members.name: roughness_map
members.doc: Grayscale roughness texture path (as downloaded texture sets have it), or None

members.name: metallic_map
members.doc: Grayscale metallic texture path, or None

members.name: metallic_roughness_map
members.doc: glTF metallic (B) / roughness (G) texture path, or None

members.name: occlusion_map
members.doc: Ambient occlusion (R) texture path, or None

members.name: emissive_map
members.doc: Emissive texture path, or None

members.name: save
members.doc: Writes the material to a .bmat file in the project

types.name: Transform
types.doc: Position, rotation and scale relative to the parent

members.name: position
members.doc: Local position (same as translation)

members.name: rotation
members.doc: Euler angles in radians

types.name: MeshRenderer
types.doc: Draws a mesh (glTF file or Builtin/Cube, Sphere, Plane, Capsule, Cylinder, Cone, Quad)

members.name: material
members.doc: Material path (.bmat or runtime material); None uses the mesh's own materials

members.name: color
members.doc: Albedo color; setting it gives the entity its own material

members.name: fov
members.doc: Vertical field of view in degrees

types.name: DirectionalLight
types.doc: Sun-like light shining along the entity's forward (-Z)

types.name: SpotLight
types.doc: Cone light shining along the entity's forward (-Z)

members.name: inner_angle
members.doc: Degrees

members.name: outer_angle
members.doc: Degrees

types.name: SkyLight
types.doc: Environment lighting: an HDRI (.hdr) or the procedural sky

members.name: rotation
members.doc: Degrees

types.name: RigidBody
types.doc: Physics body. Needs a collider component on the same entity.

members.name: type
members.doc: 'Static', 'Dynamic' or 'Kinematic' (set before play)

members.name: continuous
members.doc: Continuous collision detection for fast bodies (set before play)

members.name: velocity
members.doc: Linear velocity (play mode)

types.name: MeshCollider
types.doc: Static triangle-mesh collider built from the MeshRenderer

types.name: ScriptComponent
types.doc: Attaches a script to the entity

members.name: run_while_paused
members.doc: Keeps updating while the game is paused (pause menus); its delta time is the real frame time then

members.name: bus
members.doc: The bus the source plays on: 'Master', 'Music' or 'Effects'

types.name: NavAgent
types.doc: Walks the entity over the scene's navmesh, steering around walls and other agents. It moves the transform, so the entity has no rigid body or a kinematic one

members.name: speed
members.doc: Top speed in meters per second, from 0 to 100

members.name: acceleration
members.doc: How fast it speeds up and slows down, in meters per second per second, from 0.1 to 1000

members.name: radius
members.doc: Meters it keeps from other agents, from 0.05 to 5

members.name: height
members.doc: Meters, from 0.1 to 20

members.name: base_offset
members.doc: How far the entity's origin is above the ground, in meters (half a capsule's height, say), from -20 to 20

members.name: stopping_distance
members.doc: It arrives this close to its destination, in meters, from 0.01 to 100

members.name: turn_speed
members.doc: Degrees per second it turns to face where it walks, from 0 (it doesn't turn) to 10000

members.name: avoid_others
members.doc: Steers around other agents

members.name: velocity
members.doc: How fast and which way it's walking, in meters per second; zero while it stands or the game isn't running

members.name: destination
members.doc: Where it's walking (the navmesh spot set_destination found), or None while it stands

members.name: moving
members.doc: True from set_destination until it arrives or is stopped

members.name: set_destination
members.doc: Walks to the point (the nearest spot on the navmesh within 2 meters of it). It sends 'destination reached' when it gets there, or when it can't and stops as close as it could. False, and nothing changes, when no agent can stand near the point

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stops walking: it slows to a stop where it is, and sends no 'destination reached'

types.name: Animator
types.doc: Plays the animation clips of the entity's skinned model (its MeshRenderer's mesh), one at a time, crossfading between them

members.name: start_clip
members.doc: The clip played when the game starts; empty plays the mesh's first

members.name: loop
members.doc: When off, a clip stops at its end, holds its last pose and sends 'animation finished'

members.name: speed
members.doc: Times as fast, from -10 to 10; negative plays backward

members.name: time
members.doc: Seconds into the clip (held to its length); set it to 0 to start the clip over

members.name: clip
members.doc: The clip playing or held, or "" for none (the model stands in its rest pose)

members.name: playing
members.doc: True while the clip moves: not stopped, paused or at the end of a clip that doesn't loop

members.name: length
members.doc: The current clip's length in seconds (0 for none)

members.name: clips
members.doc: The model's clip names, in file order

members.name: bones
members.doc: The model's bone (joint) names, parents first

members.name: play
members.doc: Plays a clip, fading from the current pose over 'fade' seconds (0 cuts). Asking for the clip that's already playing changes nothing (and resumes it if paused), so it's safe every frame for a looping clip; set time to 0 to restart it. A clip that doesn't loop and has ended starts over, sending 'animation finished' again at its end

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stops the clip and holds the current pose

members.name: bone_position
members.doc: Where a bone is in the world this frame, to put something in a hand

members.name: bone_rotation
members.doc: A bone's rotation in the world this frame, in degrees like rotation

types.name: Text
types.doc: Text drawn crisp at any size: in the world (centered on its entity) or, under a UI canvas, on screen

members.name: font
members.doc: A .ttf or .otf in the assets; empty for the built-in font (Inter)

members.name: size
members.doc: The height of one em: meters for world text, reference pixels for screen text under a UI canvas

members.name: alignment
members.doc: 'left', 'center' or 'right'

members.name: vertical_alignment
members.doc: 'top', 'middle' or 'bottom'

members.name: box_size
members.doc: The box the text sits in (x width, y height; z unused); 0 sizes it to the text

members.name: wrap
members.doc: Wrap lines at the box's width

members.name: overflow
members.doc: What text past the box does: 'visible', 'clip' or 'ellipsis'

members.name: line_spacing
members.doc: A multiple of the font's line height

members.name: outline_width
members.doc: In ems, 0 to 0.1

members.name: face_camera
members.doc: World text always turned toward the camera

members.name: theme_color
members.doc: Screen text takes its color from its canvas's theme (for its widget's state) instead of color

members.name: measured_size
members.doc: The size the text takes up (x width, y height; meters, or reference pixels on a UI), for fitting boxes and backgrounds to it

types.name: ParticleEmitter
types.doc: Sends out camera-facing particles (fire, sparks, smoke, dust) in a cone around the entity's local +Y. It plays in the editor too, so the effect shows while you edit

members.name: play_on_start
members.doc: Starts playing by itself when the game starts

members.name: looping
members.doc: Starts a new cycle when one ends; otherwise it stops after one

members.name: duration
members.doc: Seconds one cycle lasts, from 0.05 to 3600

members.name: rate
members.doc: Particles per second while playing, from 0 to 10000

members.name: burst
members.doc: Particles sent at once when each cycle starts, from 0 to 10000

members.name: max_particles
members.doc: The most alive at once, from 0 to 10000; past it no more are born

members.name: lifetime
members.doc: Seconds each particle lives, from 0.01 to 600

members.name: lifetime_variation
members.doc: How much lifetimes vary, from 0 (all the same) to 1 (anywhere from none to double)

members.name: speed
members.doc: Meters per second particles leave at, from 0 to 1000

members.name: speed_variation
members.doc: How much speeds vary, from 0 to 1, like lifetime_variation

members.name: spread_angle
members.doc: Degrees from the entity's +Y they may leave at: 0 a straight line, 180 every way

members.name: shape
members.doc: Where particles are born: 'point' (the entity), 'sphere', 'box', 'ring' (a circle around +Y) or 'line' (along X)

members.name: shape_size
members.doc: A sphere's or ring's radius (x), a line's length (x) or a box's half size, in meters

members.name: outward
members.doc: Particles leave away from the center (bursts, rings that expand) instead of up +Y; spread_angle tilts them

members.name: gravity_scale
members.doc: How much the scene's gravity pulls them: 0 none, 1 full, below 0 they rise

members.name: drag
members.doc: Air resistance, from 0 to 100: how quickly they slow down

members.name: noise_strength
members.doc: A swirling push, in m/s² (wisps, embers, curling smoke); 0 is none

members.name: noise_frequency
members.doc: How tight the swirls are: swirls per meter, from 0 to 100

members.name: noise_speed
members.doc: How fast the swirls change, from 0 (still) to 100

members.name: start_size
members.doc: Meters across when born

members.name: end_size
members.doc: Meters across when it dies

members.name: size_curve
members.doc: Size over life as up to 8 [time, size] keys (time 0 born to 1 dies; size multiplies start_size), straight between keys, like [[0, 0], [0.2, 1], [1, 0]] to grow then shrink. [] goes from start_size to end_size

members.name: start_color
members.doc: Color and alpha when born (each 0 to 1)

members.name: end_color
members.doc: Color and alpha when it dies; set alpha to 0 to fade out

members.name: color_gradient
members.doc: Color over life as up to 8 [time, red, green, blue, alpha] keys (each 0 to 1), like [[0, 1, 1, 1, 1], [0.3, 0.3, 0.6, 1, 1], [1, 0, 0, 1, 0]] for a white flash fading to blue. [] goes from start_color to end_color

members.name: intensity
members.doc: Brightness, from 0 to 1000; above 1 they glow

members.name: blend
members.doc: 'additive' adds light (fire, sparks); 'alpha' covers what's behind (smoke, dust)

members.name: texture
members.doc: The image each particle shows (an asset path); empty for a soft round dot

members.name: flipbook_columns
members.doc: A flipbook texture's columns of frames, from 1 to 16 (frames go left to right, then top to bottom)

members.name: flipbook_rows
members.doc: A flipbook texture's rows of frames, from 1 to 16

members.name: flipbook_fps
members.doc: Flipbook frames per second, from 0 to 240; 0 plays the whole sheet once over each particle's life

members.name: flipbook_random_start
members.doc: Each particle starts on a random frame

members.name: facing
members.doc: 'camera' faces the camera; 'stretched' stretches along the way each moves (streaks, rain); 'flat' lies across the entity's +Y (ground rings, shockwaves)

members.name: stretch_amount
members.doc: For 'stretched': seconds of motion its length shows (length = speed × this + size), from 0 to 10

members.name: start_rotation
members.doc: Degrees each particle is turned when born

members.name: rotation_variation
members.doc: Degrees the start rotation varies either way, from 0 to 180 (180: any angle)

members.name: spin_speed
members.doc: Degrees per second each particle turns (below 0 the other way)

members.name: spin_variation
members.doc: Degrees per second the spin varies either way

members.name: world_space
members.doc: Born particles stay where they are when the entity moves; off, they move with it

members.name: play
members.doc: Starts a cycle (sending its burst), whether or not it was playing

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stops sending particles. The live ones live out their lives, unless 'clear' removes them now

members.name: emit
members.doc: Sends 'count' particles at once (up to 10000), playing or not

members.name: is_playing
members.doc: Whether it's sending particles

members.name: particle_count
members.doc: How many are alive now

types.name: Decal
types.doc: Projects an image (or a plain color) onto the opaque surfaces inside its box, down the entity's -Y with the image's top toward its -Z, lit and shadowed like the surface: footprints, cracks, posters, puddles

members.name: texture
members.doc: The image (an asset path); empty for a plain rectangle of color

members.name: color
members.doc: Tint (each 0 to 1); its alpha is the decal's opacity

members.name: size
members.doc: Meters: x the image's width, y how deep it reaches, z the image's height

members.name: max_angle
members.doc: Degrees a surface may turn from the decal's up before the decal fades out on it, from 1 to 89

members.name: sort_order
members.doc: Higher ones are drawn on top of lower ones (and win when too many are in view)

types.name: UICanvas
types.doc: The root of a screen UI: everything under it with a UIRect is laid out on screen, over the game

members.name: reference_size
members.doc: The screen size the UI is designed for, in reference pixels (x width, y height; z unused)

members.name: scale_mode
members.doc: 'fit_height', 'fit_width', 'expand' (the whole reference area fits) or 'constant_pixels'

members.name: sort_order
members.doc: Canvases with a higher sort order draw on top

members.name: modal
members.doc: While shown, it takes every key, button and click: the game and other UI get nothing (pause menus, dialogs)

members.name: theme
members.doc: The .btheme asset its UI is drawn with; "" is the built-in one, Builtin/MageCap.btheme

members.name: scale
members.doc: Screen pixels per reference pixel at the current screen size

types.name: UIRect
types.doc: Where a UI entity sits inside its parent: anchors are fractions of the parent ((0, 0) top-left, (1, 1) bottom-right), offsets are reference pixels from the anchored corners

members.name: anchor_min
members.doc: The parent's point the top-left corner follows (z unused)

members.name: anchor_max
members.doc: The parent's point the bottom-right corner follows; different anchors stretch with the parent (z unused)

members.name: pivot
members.doc: The point of the rect that stays put when its size changes ((0, 0) top-left, (1, 1) bottom-right; z unused)

members.name: offset_min
members.doc: The top-left corner's distance from anchor_min (z unused)

members.name: offset_max
members.doc: The bottom-right corner's distance from anchor_max (z unused)

members.name: position
members.doc: Where the pivot sits relative to the anchors, in reference pixels (moves both offsets; z unused)

members.name: size
members.doc: The size in reference pixels, keeping the pivot in place (with stretching anchors, the size beyond the stretched part; z unused)

members.name: visible
members.doc: Hidden rects hide everything under them too

members.name: interactable
members.doc: Whether the pointer and focus can reach it and everything under it

members.name: width_sizing
members.doc: Inside a UILayout: 'fixed' keeps its own width, 'fill' shares the space left over

members.name: height_sizing
members.doc: Inside a UILayout: 'fixed' keeps its own height, 'fill' shares the space left over

members.name: focusable
members.doc: Can take keyboard and gamepad focus (Tab, arrows, d-pad); it also stops the pointer

members.name: style_class
members.doc: A named style of its canvas's theme ("primary", "danger"); "" for the theme's plain style

members.name: hovered
members.doc: True while the pointer is over it (and it is what the pointer would use)

members.name: pressed
members.doc: True from a press on it until the button is let go

members.name: focused
members.doc: True while it has keyboard and gamepad focus

members.name: focus
members.doc: Gives it focus; False when it cannot take focus (not focusable, hidden, not interactable, or behind a modal canvas)

members.name: screen_position
members.doc: The top-left corner on screen, in pixels from the screen's top-left, as of the last frame drawn (z unused)

members.name: screen_size
members.doc: The size on screen in pixels, as of the last frame drawn (z unused)

types.name: UIImage
types.doc: A filled rectangle with optional rounded corners, border and texture, sized by the entity's UIRect

members.name: texture
members.doc: An image in the assets stretched over the rect; empty draws a plain color

members.name: color
members.doc: Multiplies the texture

members.name: corner_radius
members.doc: In reference pixels

members.name: border_width
members.doc: In reference pixels, drawn inside the rect

members.name: slice_border
members.doc: 9-slice: the texture's edges [left, top, right, bottom] in texture pixels keep their size and only the middle stretches; 0 stretches all

types.name: UIButton
types.doc: Clickable: colors its UIImage by state, from its canvas's theme unless it sets its own; a click (or ui_accept while focused) raises 'clicked'

members.name: normal_color
members.doc: Its own once set; otherwise its theme's

members.name: hover_color
members.doc: Under the pointer

members.name: pressed_color
members.doc: Held down

members.name: disabled_color
members.doc: When not interactable

members.name: clear_colors
members.doc: Goes back to its theme's colors for every state

types.name: UIToggle
types.doc: A check box; clicking flips it and raises 'changed' (on, widget)

types.name: UISlider
types.doc: A track with a knob; dragging, clicking or ui_left/ui_right while focused raise 'changed' (value, widget)

members.name: step
members.doc: Values snap to steps from min; 0 for any value

members.name: value
members.doc: Kept between min and max and snapped to step

types.name: UIDropdown
types.doc: A button that opens a list of options; picking one raises 'changed' (index, widget), and its Text shows the selection

members.name: options
members.doc: The choices, in order

members.name: selected
members.doc: The selected option's index, or -1 for none

members.name: selected_text
members.doc: The selected option, or empty

types.name: UITextInput
types.doc: A field the player types into; its text is the entity's Text. Raises 'changed' (text, widget) as it is edited and 'submitted' (text, widget) on Enter (Ctrl+Enter when multi-line)

members.name: placeholder
members.doc: Shown, dimmed, while the text is empty

members.name: multi_line
members.doc: Enter starts a new line; Ctrl+Enter submits

members.name: password
members.doc: Shows a bullet per character, on one line, and can't be copied

members.name: max_length
members.doc: The most characters it takes; 0 for no limit

types.name: UILayout
types.doc: Places the entity's children that have a UIRect: one under another, side by side, or in a grid

members.name: direction
members.doc: 'vertical', 'horizontal' or 'grid'

members.name: spacing
members.doc: Reference pixels between children

members.name: padding
members.doc: Space inside the edges: [left, top, right, bottom] in reference pixels

members.name: main_alignment
members.doc: Where the children sit along the direction when none fills: 'start', 'center' or 'end'

members.name: cross_alignment
members.doc: Where a child that doesn't fill sits across the direction: 'start', 'center' or 'end'

members.name: columns
members.doc: Columns of a grid

types.name: UIScroll
types.doc: Scrolls and clips the entity's children; the mouse wheel scrolls it, and focus scrolls hidden UI into view

members.name: scroll_position
members.doc: How far the content is scrolled, in reference pixels (kept in range when the UI is laid out; z unused)

members.name: wheel_speed
members.doc: Reference pixels per wheel notch

members.name: content_size
members.doc: The size of what it holds, in reference pixels, as of the last frame drawn (z unused)

members.name: viewport_size
members.doc: The size of the part in view, in reference pixels, as of the last frame drawn (z unused)

types.name: Group
types.doc: A Hierarchy group: a named folder the scene's top-level entities are filed under (their children follow them). It never moves anything; find one with group(name)

members.name: valid
members.doc: False once the group has been deleted

members.name: name
members.doc: Trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, and not used by another group of the scene in any letter case

members.name: note
members.doc: What the group is for, shown under its name in the Hierarchy (at most 200 characters)

members.name: icon
members.doc: The icon it shows: folder, mountain, anchor, rocket, lightbulb, layout, music, camera, box, user, users, flag, star, swords, trees or house

members.name: color
members.doc: Its icon's color, red, green and blue from 0 to 1

members.name: hidden_in_editor
members.doc: The editor's eye: its viewport doesn't draw the group's entities. The game always shows them

members.name: locked_in_editor
members.doc: The editor's lock: clicking in its viewport doesn't select the group's entities. The game is unaffected

members.name: entities
members.doc: The top-level entities in the group, in Hierarchy order

members.name: all_entities
members.doc: The top-level entities in the group and everything under them, parents before their children

members.name: has_entity
members.doc: True when the entity, or its top-level ancestor, is in the group

members.name: add_entity
members.doc: Moves a top-level entity into the group from any other, and returns false when it was already in it

members.name: remove_entity
members.doc: Takes a top-level entity out of the group, into none; false when it wasn't in it

members.name: delete
members.doc: Removes the group; its entities stay where they are, in no group

types.name: Entity
types.doc: A handle to an entity in a scene

members.name: valid
members.doc: False once the entity has been destroyed

members.name: keep_across_scenes
members.doc: The entity and its children stay when load_scene changes the scene, keeping their scripts, physics and sounds

members.name: tags
members.doc: The labels the entity has ("enemy"), in the order they were added; find them with find_tagged

members.name: add_tag
members.doc: Adds a tag, and returns false when the entity already had it. A tag is trimmed, 1 to 64 characters, and an entity has at most 32

members.name: remove_tag
members.doc: Removes a tag, and returns false when the entity didn't have it

members.name: has_tag
members.doc: True when the entity has the tag (letter case counts)

members.name: group
members.doc: The Hierarchy group the entity is in, or None. A child is in its top-level ancestor's group; only a top-level entity can be moved to another

members.name: is_in_group
members.doc: True when the entity, or its top-level ancestor, is in the group with this name (any letter case)

members.name: position
members.doc: World-space position

members.name: rotation
members.doc: Local rotation as Euler angles in degrees

members.name: text
members.doc: Its Text component's text (a label, a button's caption, world text)

members.name: visible
members.doc: Whether a UI entity (its UIRect, or its UICanvas) is shown; hiding it hides everything under it

members.name: interactable
members.doc: Whether the pointer and focus can reach a UI entity and everything under it

members.name: value
members.doc: A toggle's on/off (true or false), a slider's value, a dropdown's selected index, or a text input's text; setting it raises no 'changed'

members.name: focus
members.doc: Gives a UI entity keyboard and gamepad focus; False when it can't take focus (not focusable, hidden, not interactable, or behind a modal canvas)

members.name: find_child
members.doc: Finds a descendant by name

members.name: get_component
members.doc: Returns the component or None, e.g. entity.get_component('RigidBody')

members.name: add_component
members.doc: Adds the component (if missing) and returns it

members.name: components
members.doc: Names of the components on this entity

members.name: destroy
members.doc: Destroys the entity (at the end of the frame during play)

members.name: look_at
members.doc: Rotates the entity so -Z faces the target

members.name: rotate
members.doc: Rotates by Euler angles (degrees) in local space

types.name: Tween
types.doc: A property moving smoothly over time (what tween and tween_by return); 'tween finished' is sent when it reaches its end

members.name: id
members.doc: The ID sent with 'tween finished'

members.name: running
members.doc: True until it ends (paused or waiting for its delay counts as running)

members.name: finished
members.doc: True once it reached its end; false when it was stopped or replaced

members.name: progress
members.doc: From 0 to 1 over every repeat (the current one when repeating forever)

members.name: repeat
members.doc: How many more times it runs after the first: 0, a count, or -1 for forever

members.name: yoyo
members.doc: Every other run goes back the way it came (needs repeat)

members.name: while_paused
members.doc: Keeps moving while the game is paused (set_paused), for pause menus

members.name: stop
members.doc: Stops it where it is, sending no 'tween finished'; false when it had already ended

members.name: complete
members.doc: Jumps to the end, repeats included (the current run when repeating forever); 'tween finished' follows next frame
